mathcounts-potw-2026-04-20-02.title: Part over whole
mathcounts-potw-2026-04-20-02.body:
Planting supplies: \$64.07. Total: \$114.81 (adding the arrangement materials, \$50.74). $\frac{64.07}{114.81} \approx 0.5581 = 55.8\%$.

**Answer: 55.8%**

mathcounts-potw-2026-04-20-02.title: Complement check
mathcounts-potw-2026-04-20-02.body:
Arrangement materials are $\frac{50.74}{114.81} \approx 44.2\%$, so planting supplies are $100 - 44.2 = 55.8\%$.

**Answer: 55.8%**

mathcounts-potw-2026-04-20-03.title: Group by count
mathcounts-potw-2026-04-20-03.body:
Lilies and dahlias each bring \$60 ($4 \times 15 = 5 \times 12$), so $120 + 39 + 40 = 199$.

**Answer: \$199**
